messages:
deploy-bot: finished deploy `service/runtime` @prod (v2.9.1) to 30% canary. CI: https://ci.example/9876 :rocket:
inc-bot: ALERT p99 generation latency 4.2x above baseline for /v1/generate (region: us-west) — spike started ~00:00:45 after canary. metrics: https://metrics.example/graphs/abc123 :rotating_light:
tara_oncall: I'm on it. paging channel. Can someone pause canary or cut traffic? :hand:
sam_sre: seeing 504s and timeouts in request logs. stack traces show worker goroutine queueing on mux read. qdepth jumped ~3x. digging into pod logs now.```logs
2026-03-12T00:01:12 runtime.go:482 timeout waiting for kvcache response
2026-03-12T00:01:13 mux.go:215 request stalled
```
mike_runtime: I just confirmed the canary is using a new runtime kernel (jit-lite) that changed connection keepalive handling. Rolling back keepalive flag possible. Recommending immediate canary pause and revert to previous canary image. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: canary paused via `orchestrator pause --canary service/runtime` (user: tara_oncall)
tara_oncall: Paused. Observability still shows tail latency at p99+ elevated, but 5xx count has plateaued. Any customer hits? jess_pm can we get quick CS check?
jess_pm: Support queue: 12 reports in last 3m, mainly timeout errors for requests > 8s. One enterprise customer reported partial outage in us-west. Escalating to SE. ETA on mitigation?
eva_support: adding incident tag and contacting account owner, will update CS thread.
sam_sre: attaching quick trace sample: https://traces.example/trace/xyz — root cause looks like connection reuse under new kernel causes intermittent stall when backend kv-answer is large (~120KB). Also seen socket close during keepalive handshake.
mike_runtime: Confirmed: repro locally with stress test. New kernel changes aggressive keepalive that races with upstream read. We'll push hotfix to revert kernel flag. Preparing container image `v2.9.1-hotfix` now.
tara_oncall: If hotfix is <5m, do hotpatch to canary. If not, full canary rollback. What's the build time?
mike_runtime: Build ~90s, integration smoke ~60s. Hotpatch ETA ~3.5m. I'll kick it now.
inc-bot: deploy action started by mike_runtime: deploy --image v2.9.1-hotfix --env=canary --service=runtime
sam_sre: after hotpatch, p95 down ~25%, p99 down ~60%. 5xx rate back to baseline. Re-running synthetic tests.
jess_pm: CS reports errors subsiding, one customer confirmed recovery, will follow up.
tara_oncall: Good. Marking mitigation: hotpatch canary -> full rollout in 10m if stable. Assigning postmortem to sam_sre + mike_runtime.
mike_runtime: Rolling hotfix to remaining canaries now. Command: `orchestrator rollout --image v2.9.1-hotfix --target=canaries`
inc-bot: Rollout completed to all canaries. Post-rollout metrics: p95 ~ baseline, p99 within 5% of baseline, 5xx rate normal.
sam_sre: leaving notes: root cause = keepalive/connection-reuse regression in jit-lite kernel change; trigger = canary config toggled default keepalive timeout; mitigation = hotpatch revert to previous keepalive behavior; follow-ups: add load test for large-kv answers, add e2e regression check on keepalive semantics.
jess_pm: I'll notify affected customers and schedule incident review 16:00. Thanks team. :tada:
tara_oncall: Handoff to next oncall in 20m. I'm staying for rollout watch until then. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:
